system.longDesc: You pick up new languages easily. When you learn a new language, you learn to both speak and read it.

degree1.desc: You learn an additional language. You learn two additional languages for a total of three plus your native language(s). You can also imitate a specific dialect with a successful Communication (Performance) test.

degree2.desc: You learn three additional languages for a total of six plus your native language(s). You can also pick any one additional language you know and speak it like a native—that is, without any trace of an accent.
